headline: Xbox unveils Mythic Achievements, like PlayStation Platinum trophies
summary: Microsoft announced Xbox Mythic Achievements, a new tier comparable to PlayStation's Platinum trophies, unlocked once every original achievement in a game is earned. They are available now for Xbox Insiders to test and apply retroactively to games players have already completed.
